start.title: Wire Under Fur
start.text: A fox hangs twisted in a wire snare beside the trail, alive and exhausted. The trap is professionally set and marked with a strip of blue cloth.

choices.text: Free the fox without being bitten

buckets.flavourText: You pin the loop with a stick, loosen the wire, and give the fox room to choose its escape.
The fox panics as soon as you touch the wire and snaps at your glove.

choices.text: Kill it quickly and end its suffering

panic.title: Teeth and Wire
panic.text: The animal is too frightened to understand help. You can still cut the snare, but you will have to control its head first.

choices.text: Hold it long enough to cut the wire

buckets.flavourText: You take a shallow bite through the glove, but the wire comes free.
The wire breaks after a struggle. The fox limps away and you are left with torn leather.
The fox twists harder and the wire cuts deeper. You stop before making it worse.

released.title: Blue Cloth
released.text: The fox vanishes between the pines. The blue marker remains tied to the stake. Whoever owns the trap will know someone interfered.

marker.title: A Visible Choice
marker.text: You leave the strip of blue cloth fluttering where the trap was. The hunter will find an empty snare and know it was deliberate.

no_marker.title: No Claim Left
no_marker.text: You pocket the marker and kick snow over the stake. By morning, the trap site will look abandoned.

kill.title: A Clean End
kill.text: You make it quick. The fox goes still. The blue cloth snaps once in the wind above it.

leave.title: Not Your Snare
leave.text: You walk on. The wire gives a faint metallic sound behind you when the fox struggles again.
